race.comment: WHISKEY TUMBLER (6) was well supported in both runs in his debut campaign but couldn't quite deliver. Suspect he has his share of ability and gets his chance to break through. LITTLE BILLIE (2) was fast away here on debut earlier this month and was only run down late. Better for that and can give another bold sight. FAR MORE RADIANT (11) has been beaten similar margins in her two runs back but strips fitter now and gets the blinkers applied. Place chance. DETROIT DREAMING (10) has not raced since finishing sixth over 1500m at Yarra Valley on March 24. Finds the right race and can contest for a place.
